value.rationale: The specific inferential boundary is mathematically and ecologically motivated: full lag-by-lag conspecific co-visit data determines every additive pollen-transfer sum, but fails to predict the expected number of distinct successfully pollinated plants under the explicitly published nonlinear independent-success model. Not merely another demonstration that adjacent visits are insufficient, the two full-lag-identical nine-visit histories reverse ranking exactly once as pollen persistence changes. Minimal nontrivial binary homometry is a known sharp natural boundary; the new finite fact isolates the nonlinear response missing from that prior classification. No speculative field impact is claimed.
